easyPrerequisites: You control three untapped artifacts and/or creatures.
description:
Activate Warden of the Inner Sky by tapping three artifacts and/or creatures, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to scry 1.
Arwen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis's second ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Repeat.
